stories.title: As shutdown begins, lawmakers clash over how immigration agents operate
stories.summary: A partial government shutdown is now underway. How long it will last depends on congressional agreement over a DHS funding deal that proposes new guardrails on immigration enforcement.

stories.title: How the blockade between Afghanistan and Pakistan is affecting people on both sides
stories.summary: Borders between Pakistan and Afghanistan have been closed since October, disrupting trade around the region. It's part of a broader dispute over how to handle increasingly active militant groups.

stories.title: 'Getting to Reparations' argues a clear path and legal strategy to atone for slavery
stories.summary: Dorothy Brown, a Georgetown University law professor, lays out a case for reparations in her new book Getting to Reparations: How Building a Different America Requires a Reckoning with Our Past.

stories.title: Madison Beer on the themes she unlocks in 'Locket'
stories.summary: Madison Beer talks about her new album 'Locket', and growing up in the public eye since age 13.

stories.title: Israel advances a 'lost tribe' immigration plan despite discredited ancestry claims
stories.summary: Who are the Bnei Menashe, an ethnic group from India that has been immigrating to Israel? Judy Maltz of Ha'aretz has covered the community for more than a decade.

stories.title: A stencil of a handprint in an Indonesian cave is the oldest known rock art
stories.summary: Scientists have discovered what they say is the earliest known rock art, in a cave in Indonesia. They say the image dates to more than 67,000 years ago.
